**What are you trying to do?**
Describe the goal, not just the implementation you have in mind.

**Is this language-specific?**
If you're requesting support for a language/script this project doesn't explicitly mention yet: note that the RTL fix already works at the Unicode bidi-algorithm level (`unicode-bidi: plaintext`), so most right-to-left scripts should already render correctly with the existing patch — this request might just be a documentation gap rather than a code change. Please confirm whether you've actually tested the current patch on your language first.

**Proposed approach (optional)**
If you have an idea of how this should work, describe it here. No need to write code.

**Alternatives considered**
Any other way to solve the same problem you're aware of.
